scoped_aggregate_sql:
SELECT vehicles.id, vehicles.vehicle_type 
FROM vehicles 
WHERE vehicles.status != 'INATIVO'

SELECT fuel_supplies.vehicle_id, max(fuel_supplies.odometer_km) AS max_odometer, min(fuel_supplies.odometer_km) AS min_odometer, sum(fuel_supplies.liters) AS sum_liters, sum(coalesce(fuel_supplies.total_amount, 0)) AS sum_fuel_cost, sum(CASE WHEN (fuel_supplies.is_consumption_anomaly IS true) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS anomalies_count 
FROM fuel_supplies 
WHERE (fuel_supplies.organization_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000002a' OR fuel_supplies.organization_id IS NULL AND (SELECT min(CAST(master_departments.organization_id AS VARCHAR)) AS min_1 
FROM location_history AS location_history_1 JOIN master_allocations ON master_allocations.id = location_history_1.allocation_id JOIN master_departments ON master_departments.id = master_allocations.department_id 
WHERE location_history_1.vehicle_id = fuel_supplies.vehicle_id AND location_history_1.start_date <= fuel_supplies.supplied_at AND (location_history_1.end_date IS NULL OR location_history_1.end_date > fuel_supplies.supplied_at) 
HAVING count(distinct(master_departments.organization_id)) = 1) = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000002a') AND fuel_supplies.supplied_at >= '2026-09-06 00:00:00+00:00' AND fuel_supplies.supplied_at <= '2026-10-06 00:00:00+00:00' GROUP BY fuel_supplies.vehicle_id

SELECT maintenance_records.vehicle_id, sum(maintenance_records.total_cost) AS sum_cost 
FROM maintenance_records 
WHERE (maintenance_records.responsible_organization_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000002a' OR maintenance_records.responsible_organization_id IS NULL AND (SELECT min(CAST(master_departments.organization_id AS VARCHAR)) AS min_1 
FROM location_history AS location_history_1 JOIN master_allocations ON master_allocations.id = location_history_1.allocation_id JOIN master_departments ON master_departments.id = master_allocations.department_id 
WHERE location_history_1.vehicle_id = maintenance_records.vehicle_id AND location_history_1.start_date <= maintenance_records.start_date AND (location_history_1.end_date IS NULL OR location_history_1.end_date > maintenance_records.start_date) 
HAVING count(distinct(master_departments.organization_id)) = 1) = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000002a') AND maintenance_records.start_date >= '2026-09-06 00:00:00+00:00' AND maintenance_records.start_date <= '2026-10-06 00:00:00+00:00' GROUP BY maintenance_records.vehicle_id

SELECT fines.vehicle_id, sum(fines.amount) AS sum_cost 
FROM fines 
WHERE (fines.responsible_organization_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000002a' OR fines.responsible_organization_id IS NULL AND (SELECT min(CAST(master_departments.organization_id AS VARCHAR)) AS min_1 
FROM location_history AS location_history_1 JOIN master_allocations ON master_allocations.id = location_history_1.allocation_id JOIN master_departments ON master_departments.id = master_allocations.department_id 
WHERE location_history_1.vehicle_id = fines.vehicle_id AND location_history_1.start_date <= timezone('America/Bahia', fines.infraction_date + coalesce(fines.infraction_time, '00:00:00')) AND (location_history_1.end_date IS NULL OR location_history_1.end_date > CASE WHEN (fines.infraction_time IS NULL) THEN timezone('America/Bahia', fines.infraction_date + coalesce(fines.infraction_time, '00:00:00')) + INTERVAL '1 day' - INTERVAL '1 microsecond' ELSE timezone('America/Bahia', fines.infraction_date + coalesce(fines.infraction_time, '00:00:00')) END) 
HAVING count(distinct(master_departments.organization_id)) = 1) = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-00000000002a') AND fines.infraction_date >= '2026-09-06' AND fines.infraction_date <= '2026-10-06' GROUP BY fines.vehicle_id

SELECT drivers.id, drivers.nome_completo 
FROM drivers 
WHERE drivers.ativo IS true
